visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with wavy dark hair, wearing a blue denim shirt and tan shorts, sits on a grey fabric couch. He holds a smartphone with a pink wavy strap and looks at the screen with an expressive, gossipy facial expression. The background is a plain white wall. (2) He turns the smartphone screen outward. Suddenly, three other people lean into the frame from the sides: a man with heavy makeup and a ponytail wearing a lime green tube top, a man in a striped shirt and tie, and a woman in a white jersey. They all stare intently at the phone screen. (3) The camera cuts to different angles showing the group's concentrated faces. The man in the green tube top stares blankly at the screen while the others look increasingly impatient. Labels with text appear near the characters' heads. (4) The original man pulls the phone back toward himself, looking physically exhausted and rubbing his forearm as if it is sore from holding the phone up for too long. The others remain in their leaning positions, staring at the empty space. (5) The screen filter changes to black and white, focusing on a close-up of the man in the green tube top, who maintains a confused or slow-processing expression. A red text overlay appears in the center.
